subject: Renewal & capacity increase — reserved pool expansion and throughput guarantees
messages:
From: Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudforge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: contract@cloudforge.com, ops-lead@cloudforge.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity expansion — reserved pool needs

Hi Laura,

We're getting close to our renewal window (May 15) and would like to lock in a reserved pool that doubles our current capacity. We're on 16 reserved GPUs today and want to move to 32 for the next term. Key asks from our side:

- A clear per-hour reserved rate for the 32-GPU pool (we're expecting a step-down on per-GPU price with a larger commit).
- A baseline throughput guarantee (we run steady batch inference at peak and need to avoid throttling).
- A flexible staircase approach so we can ramp for month 1–3 before full capacity is required.

Can you send an updated commercial with options (12 vs 24 month) and any recommended mitigations (burst capacity, fallback models) if we need to temporarily exceed the pool? Legal is looped in for checking SOW terms.

Thanks — Marco
Marco Ruiz
CTO, CloudForge
marco@cloudforge.com
+1 415 555 0199

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudforge.com>
Cc: contract@cloudforge.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-01T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity expansion — reserved pool needs

Hi Marco — thanks for the clear ask. High level proposal attached (proposal_v3.pdf); summary below.

Options (reserved pool = 32 GPUs):

1) 12-month term — standard commit
   - Per-GPU reserved hourly rate: $3.15/hr (billed monthly)
   - Throughput guarantee: 99.5% pool availability; baseline sustained throughput SLA equivalent to 14 infer/sec per GPU for standard vision/text models.
   - Staircase ramp: first 90 days we allow a 50% billed ramp (i.e., month 1 billed at 20 GPUs equivalent, month 2 at 26, month 3 at 32) with fixed per-hour rate above.

2) 24-month term — committed discount
   - Per-GPU reserved hourly rate: $2.85/hr
   - Throughput guarantee: 99.8% availability; same sustained throughput floor + 10% burst buffer for transient spikes.
   - Included: one free model quantization review + recommended KV cache tuning to reduce token cost.

Add-ons:
- On-demand burst pool: additional GPU capacity at $6.50/hr per GPU up to pre-agreed burst hours/month.
- Canary fallback policy: automatic routing to compatible quantized variants if primary model performance degrades — reduces risk of an outage.

I've attached the pricing workbook and a clean SOW (amended_SOW_CloudForge_0327.pdf). If you prefer a slightly more aggressive per-hour rate for 12 months, we can consider an upsell discount tied to a 60% prepaid commit.

Next step: your preference on term + whether legal wants redlines in the SOW. If acceptable, I can prepare an amendment and DocuSign link.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-01T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: CloudForge renewal — margin / concessions plan

Team — quick internal thread to align before I go back to Marco. TL;DR: CloudForge wants 2x capacity; we can get the deal with a term discount and a ramp. Proposed concessions and rationale below.

Ask from CF: 32 GPUs, throughput SLA, ramp flexibility.

Proposed commercial structure (what I'll present):
- Primary offer: 24-month at $2.85/hr (per GPU reserved) — conservative but locks a multi-year commit.
- Fallback: 12-month at $3.15/hr with 60% prepaid option for an additional $0.20/hr discount.
- Ramp billing: allow staircase billing months 1–3 to ease their cash flow; full capacity billing starts month 4.
- Burst capacity: price on-demand at $6.50/hr; cap burst hours per month to protect utilization.

Key negotiation levers (internal):
- Include one complimentary quantization/ops review to drive long-term adoption (low direct cost, high stickiness).
- Push for a usage SLA credit formula that starts at 99.5% — don't give 99.9% for 12-month. Reserve 99.8–99.9 for 24-month.

Questions for pricing: can we absorb the $0.30/hr delta between 12- and 24-month in our blended margin if we include the prepaid? Karthik — can you confirm the lowest floor we can offer if they prepay 60% for 12 months?

Grateful for quick confirmations — I want to send final commercial by tomorrow EOD.

— Laura

From: Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudforge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: contract@cloudforge.com, ops-lead@cloudforge.com
Date: 2027-04-02T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity expansion — reserved pool needs

Laura — this looks good. CloudForge is inclined to go with the 24-month commitment at $2.85/hr per GPU, subject to a couple of small SOW clarifications (we'll send redlines). Two quick asks before I sign:

1) Can we confirm the exact SLA credit formula if availability falls below 99.8%? We need a transparent credit cap and measurement window.
2) Please include the on-demand burst hours cap and how unused burst hours roll (or do not roll) between months.

If you can add those clarifications in the SOW, Legal will review the redlines and I can route the DocuSign. Please send the final amendment and link.

Thanks — Marco
